$comment: How many lanes may run at once on each subscription. scripts/lib/parallelism.mjs reads this; the cockpit shows the result and the orchestrator must not fan out past it. Values are starting points the owner edits; usage above `throttle_at` of the plan's limit drops to one lane so the remaining budget finishes the current work instead of starting more.

pro.why: Small plan: lanes run in sequence so a session does not hit its limit mid-task.

max5x.why: Room for a few subagents at once.

max20x.why: Large plan: parallel lanes up to the disjoint-file fence.

api.why: Pay per token: bounded by cost, not by a plan limit; set SVC_MAX_PARALLEL to change it.
